description: The kinds of business WRDO lists in the Western Cape, with how many of each, for a town or suburb or everywhere. Answers "what is there in Paarl?". Each slug is a valid "category" for search_local_businesses. Most businesses first; categories with none are left out. Outside the Western Cape it returns nothing. No business details, no contact details.

where.description: A town or suburb in the Western Cape, e.g. "Paarl" or "Val de Vie, Paarl". Leave out for the whole Western Cape.

name: list_categories
title: List categories
